name: jar-world
use: intro scene 1 hero, no-WebGL fallback, about
subject: The same simple cylindrical glass terrarium jar with a thick peat-brown cork stopper, seen straight on at eye level, now holding a tiny lush world: a mossy floor with small stones, ferns and clover, a little pool, a few glowing lichen-yellow seeds, and five or six tiny soft segmented creatures (like small isopods with little legs) in violet, salmonberry and lichen colours walking on the moss. The glass is see-through: paint only its pale celadon edges, bold vertical window highlights on the upper left, a cyan-green refraction band on the right edge, the rim and the thick base. No glow, halo or shadow around the jar.

name: fg-moss
subject: A wide horizontal foreground strip for a parallax layer: a low bank of soft cushion moss, small ferns curling up, clover, a few round pebbles and two tiny pink flower buds, spanning the full width of the image along the bottom edge, its top edge irregular and organic, filling roughly the lower 45% of the image; everything above it is empty. Seen from very low and close, slightly soft focus as if near the camera.

name: mid-rocks
subject: A wide horizontal midground strip for a parallax layer: a cluster of rounded mossy stones of different sizes and a small still pool of water reflecting the light between them, low ferns and a fallen twig, spanning most of the image width and sitting in the lower 60% of the image; everything above is empty. Medium distance, crisp.

name: bg-fog
subject: The far background of an enormous glass terrarium seen from inside: soft celadon fog, the blurred curved glass wall catching warm afternoon light, tall diagonal shafts of warm light falling from the upper left through the fog, faint silhouettes of distant tall ferns and a mossy slope, very soft and atmospheric, low contrast, with the lower third slightly darker deep moss green.

name: leaves-left
use: intro framing layer, left edge, closest to camera
subject: A cluster of large broad leaves and fern fronds entering from the left edge of the image, as if very close to the camera, slightly out of focus, deep moss green with warm rim light on the upper edges; the leaves touch the left edge and occupy the left 55% of the image; the rest is empty.

name: leaves-right
use: intro framing layer, right edge, closest to camera
subject: A cluster of large round leaves and a curling fern frond entering from the right edge of the image, as if very close to the camera, slightly out of focus, deep moss green and teal with a cool fill light; the leaves touch the right edge and occupy the right 55% of the image; the rest is empty.

name: species-violet
subject: A naturalist's body-part sheet for one small invented creature species, each part painted separately and widely spaced on the sheet with clear empty space between parts, all lit the same way, all in beetle violet with small lichen-yellow spots: one rounded head with two small dark eyes and two short antennae (facing right), three body segments of slightly decreasing size (rounded, plated like a pill bug's shell, seen from the side), one upper leg piece and one lower leg piece (thin, jointed), and one small tail piece. Six to eight separate pieces in two neat rows, none touching.

name: species-salmon
subject: A naturalist's body-part sheet for one small invented creature species, each part painted separately and widely spaced on the sheet with clear empty space between parts, all lit the same way, in salmonberry pink with pale cream bellies: one long narrow head with two small dark eyes and two long curved antennae (facing right), three long soft body segments (seen from the side, slightly translucent at the edges), one long thin upper leg piece and one long thin lower leg piece, and a small forked tail piece. Six to eight separate pieces in two neat rows, none touching.

name: species-lichen
subject: A naturalist's body-part sheet for one small invented creature species, each part painted separately and widely spaced on the sheet with clear empty space between parts, all lit the same way, in lichen yellow with deep moss green bands: one round stubby head with two small dark eyes and no antennae (facing right), three round fat body segments (seen from the side), one short stout upper leg piece and one short stout lower leg piece, and a tiny round tail piece. Six to eight separate pieces in two neat rows, none touching.

name: particles
subject: A sprite sheet of tiny floating particles, each separate and widely spaced in a loose grid with lots of empty space: four soft glowing spore-cyan spores, four fuzzy lichen-yellow pollen grains, four small glowing lichen-yellow seeds (food), three translucent celadon dust motes, and three tiny curled seed fluffs. Each particle is a separate small object, none touching.

name: preloader-sprout
subject: A single tiny seed, peat brown, just splitting open with one pale green sprout and two small round first leaves rising from it, with a single warm drop of light on the top leaf; centred, small in the frame with lots of empty space around.

name: gene-strand
subject: A long gently curving horizontal strand of about twelve small round glassy beads strung on a fine thread, like a naturalist's model of a gene sequence, each bead a different soft colour from the palette (violet, salmonberry, lichen, celadon, spore cyan glowing faintly, peat), spanning the width of the image through the middle.

name: room-backdrop
use: live scene backdrop behind the 3D jar
subject: A quiet room at the end of the afternoon, seen out of focus as a soft background: a wooden table top in the lower third receding back, a tall window on the far left letting in warm light, potted plants as soft shapes on the right, celadon walls in deep shade, very low detail and very soft, no objects in the centre of the image (the centre must stay calm and empty because a 3D jar will be rendered in front of it).

name: moss-floor
subject: A seamless tileable top-down texture of a terrarium floor: cushion moss in several greens with small patches of dark peat soil and a few tiny pebbles, evenly lit from above (no strong directional shadows so it tiles), even density across the whole square, edges must tile seamlessly.

name: paper-grain
use: UI panel and page grain texture (seamless)
subject: A seamless tileable texture of fine cold-pressed watercolour paper tinted pale celadon #C9D8D2, very subtle fibres and grain, perfectly even tone across the square, edges must tile seamlessly, no stains, no vignette.
